name: Seated Barbell Wrist Curl (Overhand / Extension)
description: The seated barbell wrist curl performed overhand (pronated grip) targets the wrist extensor muscles on the back of the forearm. The lifter sits at a bench with the forearms resting on the thighs, bar hanging in a pronated grip, and extends the wrists upward against resistance. This exercise balances the commonly trained wrist flexors and helps prevent wrist extensor weakness-related elbow pain.

execution.starting_position: Sit on a bench. Rest the forearms on the thighs, hands just past the knees, pronated grip on the barbell. Wrists hanging in flexion.
execution.setup_instructions: Use a very light weight — wrist extensors are small muscles. EZ-bar is a comfortable alternative.
steps: Step 1: Begin with wrists in slight flexion, bar hanging in the pronated grip.
Step 2: Extend the wrists upward, raising the back of the hands toward the ceiling.
Step 3: Hold briefly at full extension.
Step 4: Lower the wrists back to the starting position with control.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
common_mistakes: Using too much weight, causing the arms to lift off the thighs
Wrist deviation rather than pure extension
safety_considerations: Very small range of motion — do not load heavily
